content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(KOI-004 VSCode Extension Reads AWS Credentials And SSH Keys In Activate) OR BIOC(KOI-004 VSCode Extension Activate Beacons Outbound To Non Microsoft Domain) OR XQL(KOI-004 VSCode Marketplace VSIX Fetch From Non Canonical CDN) — stitched by shared agent_hostname + causality_id (CGO = code/node) so the .vsix marketplace fetch (endpoint_network_stitch), the activation credential read, and the outbound beacon (exploit_impact) collapse into ONE IDE-extension credential-theft incident
rules.name: Agentic Supply Chain — Malicious IDE Extension Credential Theft
